_description: Canonical UUID schemas for deterministic entity identity across all projections.
_note: UUIDs are deterministic: char_NNN, loc_NNN, obj_NNN, event_NNN, faction_NNN. NNN is zero-padded ordinal of first appearance in source text.

character.description: First-appeared character. Ordinal = order of first mention in full_text.md.

location.description: First-appeared location. Ordinal = order of first mention.

object.description: Significant object/artifact. Ordinal = order of first mention.

event.description: Narrative event/scene. Ordinal = order of occurrence in text.

faction.description: Group/organization. Ordinal = order of first mention.

rules: UUIDs are assigned at canon creation time and never reassigned.
If entity is split later, original UUID stays with the primary; derived entity gets new UUID.
Cross-references between projections use these UUIDs as stable keys.
